install.windows_download: Open https://www.trae.ai/download in the browser, click the Windows installer. Saves to %USERPROFILE%\Downloads by default.
install.macos_download: Open https://www.trae.ai/download in the browser, click the macOS download (.dmg). Saves to ~/Downloads by default.
install.linux_download: Open https://www.trae.ai/download and select the TRAE IDE Linux .deb / .rpm matching the architecture and distribution. Install the downloaded package with apt / dnf / zypper. The download center also lists other TRAE products; select the IDE for this tool card.
install.note: GUI IDE by ByteDance — VS Code fork with built-in AI. Echobird does NOT switch its model; model selection lives inside the app.

install_flow.summary: Select the IDE installer for the target OS and architecture → install → verify the application entry.
agent_steps: Detect OS and architecture first. The official download center supports Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Open https://www.trae.ai/download and select the TRAE IDE for this tool card. Keep the international / China build distinct from other products in the download center.

Save the matching installer to Downloads and report the exact path. Windows/macOS: open it and let the user complete the installer. Linux: install the downloaded .deb / .rpm with the distro package manager.
Verify the selected IDE is present in the application menu and opens.
tell_user: That Trae handles its own model selection — Echobird does NOT switch models for it

identity_guard.description: Trae is the international (trae.ai) build by ByteDance. It is DIFFERENT from Trae CN (trae.cn), which is the China-region build. If the user is in mainland China and has trouble reaching trae.ai, suggest Trae CN instead.

blocked_regions.zh-CN: trae.ai may be slow / blocked in mainland China — suggest installing Trae CN (trae.cn) instead.
